description: Read-only, bank-level UPI reliability context from NPCI's public monthly statistics. Monthly data: it cannot say a bank is down right now, and it is not a per-transaction diagnosis. Use the transaction's own gateway error code first.

tools.name: list_banks
tools.description: List the banks in NPCI's monthly top-50 table. Use to resolve a bank name before other calls.

month.description: YYYY-MM. NPCI usually publishes the previous month around month-end; the latest month may be missing.

side.description: remitter = payer's bank (the bank that debits).

tools.name: get_bank_stats
tools.description: Approved %, business-decline %, technical-decline % and debit-reversal success for one bank in one month. For a failed AutoPay debit use side=remitter (the payer's bank).

bank.description: Bank name or unique fragment, case-insensitive. Ambiguous names return an error listing the matches.

tools.name: compare_banks
tools.description: Side-by-side stats for 2 to 10 banks in one month.

tools.name: worst_banks_by_td
tools.description: The n banks with the highest technical-decline rate in a month (bank or NPCI system problems, as opposed to customer-side business declines).

tools.name: monthly_trend
tools.description: One metric for one bank across 2 to 12 months. Months NPCI has not published come back as null.

tools.name: get_uptime
tools.description: NPCI's own monthly UPI uptime % (including scheduled downtime), unscheduled downtime minutes and incident count. Published with an irregular lag: recent months are often missing (NotFound).

tools.name: get_autopay_bank_stats
tools.description: NPCI AutoPay (mandate) statistics for one remitter bank: approved %, business-decline % and technical-decline %. kind=execution covers recurring debits (the retry-relevant table); kind=registration covers mandate set-up. NPCI does not state the unit of volume.

tools.name: worst_autopay_banks_by_td
tools.description: The n AutoPay remitter banks with the highest technical-decline rate in a month.

tools.name: recommend_retry
tools.description: Bank-level retry guidance after a failed UPI AutoPay debit: action, retry window in hours, attempt cap, whether to nudge the customer, plus the reasoning and caveats. Pass failure_type from the transaction's own gateway error code (technical = system-side, business = customer-side, unknown if unclassified). Uses monthly data, so it cannot tell whether the bank is down right now. It adjusts a default retry policy and does not diagnose a payment.

lookback_months.description: Months to check for chronic unreliability. Each extra month may cost one cached request to NPCI.
